name: Metro Brands Ltd
about: The company is one of the largest Indian footwear & accessories specialty retailers and are among the aspirational Indian brands in the footwear category.Its a one-stop shop for of branded products for the entire family, including men, women, unisex, and children, and for every occasion, including casual and formal events.[1]
keyPoints: Network as of Q2 FY26[1][2] Store Formats: 8 Stores: 966 States: 31 Cities: 211 (expanded 6 new cities H1 FY26) Loyalty membership: 18+ mn Vendors: 250
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 76.0%
cons: Stock is trading at 10.7 times its book value
